mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.owner_user_id, p.name, p.description, p.cover_url, p.genre, p.aspect_ratio, p.visibility_scope, p.status, p.art_style, p.art_style_description, p.art_style_image_prompt, p.art_style_image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.created_by, p.updated_by, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS shot_count FROM manga_project p LEFT JOIN manga_storyboard_shot s ON s.project_id = p.id

GROUP BY p.id, p.owner_user_id, p.name, p.description, p.cover_url, p.genre, p.aspect_ratio, p.visibility_scope, p.status, p.art_style, p.art_style_description, p.art_style_image_prompt, p.art_style_image_url, p.created_at, p.updated_at, p.created_by, p.updated_by
mapper.select:
WHERE p.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_project SET name = #{project.name}, description = #{project.description}, cover_url = #{project.coverUrl}, genre = #{project.genre}, aspect_ratio = #{project.aspectRatio}, visibility_scope = #{project.visibilityScope}, status = #{project.status}, art_style = #{project.artStyle}, art_style_description = #{project.artStyleDescription}, art_style_image_prompt = #{project.artStyleImagePrompt}, art_style_image_url = #{project.artStyleImageUrl}, updated_by = #{project.updatedBy} WHERE id = #{project.id} AND owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId}
